findings.summary: Jacqui Safra is a key Epstein social network node connecting to: (1) Safra banking dynasty (nephew of Edmond Safra, RNB founder); (2) Ronald Lauder (Mega Group) via Jerusalem real estate negotiations; (3) John Brockman/Edge Foundation (science/tech elite); (4) Peggy Siegal (NYC socialite/publicist); (5) Jean Doumanian (TV producer). Jacqui's failed bank loan (June 2010) and Jerusalem property sale attempts to Epstein suggest financial interdependence. Family relationship to Edmond Safra (RNB founder, died 1999) is the indirect link between Epstein network and Republic National Bank.
John Brockman emailed Epstein about Jacqui Safra (Safra banking family) seeking investment backing -- Safra committed $25K to EDGE website platform, Brockman asked if Epstein was interested
findings.detail: EFTA02413047: June 16, 2010 email from John Brockman to Jeffrey Epstein, subject line 'Jacqui Safra.' Brockman reports having dinner with Jacqui Safra, who was 'scrambling because his loan at one of the big banks is not getting renewed' and asks 'Something for you??' Brockman then mentions Ronna Tanenbaum putting together a team to re-engineer the EDGE website and create a new Internet platform, stating 'Jacqui is in for $25K. Interested?' This email establishes: (1) Brockman knew both Epstein and Jacqui Safra personally, (2) Safra was discussed as a potential joint investor with Epstein, (3) Safra was having banking difficulties. Jacqui Safra is a major art collector and member of the Safra banking dynasty.
